description: This file defines a static class 'RuntimeVersion' that provides a property to retrieve the current version of the Orleans runtime, including debug/release info, and a method to check if an assembly was built in debug mode.

classes.name: RuntimeVersion
classes.description: A static class providing runtime version information and debug build status check.

methods.name: Current
methods.description: Gets the full version string of the Orleans runtime, including debug or release build info.

methods.name: IsAssemblyDebugBuild
methods.description: Determines whether a given assembly was built in debug mode.
